passenger_response.subject: Your claim for booking AER-9L5D2R
passenger_response.body:
Dear Marta Kowalczyk,

Our record shows that flight AK808 on 2026-08-03 was cancelled because of WEATHER: freezing fog at EDI, with RVR below operating minima from 17:20-23:00 local. The crew were on stand and within hours at the time of cancellation. This differs from your understanding that the cause was crew.

The recorded great-circle distance was 665 km, placing the flight in Band A. Because the recorded cause was weather, an extraordinary circumstance, compensation is not payable. The arrival delay at the final destination is not recorded because the flight was cancelled and there was no arrival. The duty of care is unaffected. This includes eligible meals and refreshments, communication, hotel accommodation and transport costs.

You also asked to be reimbursed £112 for the hotel you booked in Edinburgh overnight. This needs a colleague to review it. The handover has not been completed; no decision has been made.

This needs a colleague to review it. The handover has not been completed; no decision has been made.

Kind regards
